newsitem.title: PERU: Peru woman stows dead mother as luggage on bus.
newsitem.headline: Peru woman stows dead mother as luggage on bus.

text.p: A Peruvian woman stowed her dead mother as luggage in the hold of a passenger bus hoping to transport the deceased for burial in her birthplace, state news agency Andina reported Thursday.
Before boarding a bus for the bumpy 200-mile (310-km) ride from the capital Lima to the jungle town of Jauja, Matilde Cano, 50, wrapped her mother in blankets and stuffed the body below.
The bundle went unnoticed by transport officials, but as the vehicle pulled out of Lima a routine police search for drugs revealed the unusual cargo.
Cano claimed she improvised the transport for her mother, who died aged 95, because she could not afford to move the body by more conventional means.
Police identified the deceased as Fortunata Estrella, which translates as "Lucky Star".
